command:
set -eu
rpm -q rsyslog
command -v rsyslogd >/dev/null
install -d -o root -g root -m 0750 /var/lib/infraset-app/data
printf '%s\n' 'record-id=1001|owner=prepared|status=active' > /var/lib/infraset-app/data/records.db
chmod 0640 /var/lib/infraset-app/data/records.db
cat > /etc/rsyslog.d/99-infraset-app.conf <<'EOF'
module(load="imtcp")
input(type="imtcp" port="5515")
local0.* /var/log/infraset-app.log
EOF
touch /var/log/infraset-app.log
chown root:root /var/log/infraset-app.log
chmod 0640 /var/log/infraset-app.log
systemctl disable --now rsyslog || true
chcon -t tmp_t /var/log/infraset-app.log
